"""Customer support ticket transition workflow."""
from typing import Dict, Set, Any
from errors import ServiceError
from ticket_models import SupportTicket

TICKET_TRANSITIONS: Dict[str, Set[str]] = {
    "CREATED": {"ASSIGNED", "CLOSED"},
    "ASSIGNED": {"IN_PROGRESS", "CLOSED"},
    "IN_PROGRESS": {"RESOLVED", "ASSIGNED"},
    "RESOLVED": {"CLOSED", "IN_PROGRESS"},
    "CLOSED": set(),
}

def transition_ticket(ticket: SupportTicket, next_state: str, actor_id: str, timestamp_ms: int) -> None:
    """Applies status change to support ticket, validating transitions and recording audits."""
    old_state = ticket.state

    if old_state == next_state:
        # No actual state change, so no transition to validate or audit.
        return

    allowed_next_states = TICKET_TRANSITIONS.get(old_state)

    if not allowed_next_states or next_state not in allowed_next_states:
        raise ServiceError(
            code="ERR_INVALID_TRANSITION",
            message=f"Invalid transition from '{old_state}' to '{next_state}'"
        )

    ticket.state = next_state

    audit_tuple = ("STATE_TRANSITION", ticket.entity_id, old_state, next_state, actor_id, timestamp_ms)
    ticket.audit_trail.append(audit_tuple)

def get_ticket_status(ticket: SupportTicket) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {"id": ticket.entity_id, "state": ticket.state, "closed": ticket.is_closed()}
